Superstable in the forking sense (def:p03-stability-spectrum) implies lambda-stable for every lambda >= 2^|T|: not proved. thm:p03-w03-p03-032-superstable proves (1) lambda-stable for all lambda >= 2^|T| => (2) lambda-stable for one lambda with lambda^aleph0 > lambda >= 2^aleph0 => (3) stable and Deg_m(x=x) < infinity => (4) forking-superstable. Missing: (3) => (1) (Shelah 1971 Theorems 6.6, 6.7, 6.9: bounded number of same-degree extensions, which needs Theorem 5.8 Delta-indiscernible subsequences in stable theories) and (4) => (3).

Random graph separation (simple, unstable): proved in w03-p03-031 (thm:p03-w03-p03-031-random-graph with annex proof; order property of the edge relation argued in def:p03-w03-p03-031-random-graph-example, an example environment, not an annex item); cross-referenced here, not duplicated.
